overall: The AG resolved the complaint by informal action, finding that one Authority member individually violated the Open Meeting Law by emailing a quorum his opinion on public business, though the violation was not intentional.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Authority deliberated outside a properly posted meeting through an email exchange among members.
allegations.key_passage: we find that a member of the Authority, Mr. Abatiello, individually violated the Open Meeting Law by sending an email on May 29, 2013, sharing his opinion on a matter of public business within the Board's jurisdiction with a quorum of the Board.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
Disclose the May 29, 2013 email exchange during a properly posted open meeting
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and order the Authority to disclose the May 29, 2013 email exchange during a properly posted open meeting.
